title: Will my child have the same therapist or are changes possible over time at Pinnacle?
metaTitle: Continuity and Changes in Therapist Assignment at Pinnacle Blooms
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network diligently manages your child's journey, enabling both continuity and necessary changes in therapist assignment during therapy.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we strive to maintain continuity with the same therapist as this often facilitates rapport and progress. Nonetheless, there could be instances where changes are necessary, be it due to scheduling or the need for expertise in a particular domain. Rest assured, such transitions are conducted thoughtfully to ensure your child's therapy continues smoothly and effectively.
